judgment.rationale: The submission matches the rubric on every checked point. Unchanged child parts are 705,500 INR, the local pack cost is 726,090 INR and the unit saving is 103,910 INR. The volume is 110,000 packs a year for 5 years, taken from approved record-17. The 150,000-pack figure in draft record-22 is explicitly excluded. Ownership is stated as 49:51 EvTronics:EV Batteries Inc. The annual saving (103,910 × 110,000 = 11,430,100,000 INR, or 1,143.01 crore) and the 5-year saving (57,150,500,000 INR, or 5,715.05 crore) are arithmetically correct. The document states that cells remain imported and that forex exposure is only partly reduced, and it does not describe assembly-only localisation as full cell localisation. Capex and the effects of tax and duty are flagged as unquantified. The structure, sourcing model, roadmap, benefits, risks and next steps are all present. Roadmap timing is described as indicative, and the PMP policy is treated as a scenario assumption. The requested 2–3 page length is a layout matter outside this content review. One minor point: the 'Phase 2' roadmap line on localising housing and connectors is an interpretation of the PMP phases, but it is framed as indicative and is not material.
